questions.label: What is your full name?
questions.help: Use the name you want our preparer to use when contacting you. No identification document is needed here.

questions.label: Which email can our team use to contact you?
Which tax year are you filing for?
questions.help: The tax year is the year your income and activity relate to, not necessarily the year you submit the return.

questions.label: Enter the four-digit tax year.
Which states did you live in or do business in during that year?
questions.help: List state names only. Include states where you moved, worked, or had business activity so your preparer can check state filing needs.

questions.label: What was your marital status on December 31?
questions.help: Choose the status that applied at year-end. Your preparer will determine the correct filing status from your circumstances.

questions.label: What was your U.S. tax residency status?
questions.help: Immigration status and tax residency can differ. Select Not sure if you need help.

questions.label: Which visa/status did you hold, and in which years were you present in the U.S.? Do not enter ID numbers.
Might you claim any children or other dependents?
questions.help: This can include children or other relatives. Being related or paying support alone does not establish eligibility; we will review the facts.

questions.label: For each possible dependent, give age, relationship, months living with you, student status, support details, and whether anyone else may claim them. No names or IDs needed.
Did you receive employee wages (W-2)?
questions.help: Employee wages are usually reported on Form W-2. Freelance or gig work is asked about separately.

questions.label: Any freelance, gig, cash, or self-employment income?
questions.help: Include freelancing, delivery apps, consulting, a side business, or cash work, even if you did not receive a 1099.

questions.label: What kind of work did you do, and did you track expenses or business mileage?
Any interest, dividends, stock sales, or digital asset transactions?
questions.help: Include bank interest, dividends, investment sales and digital asset activity. Your team will clarify which records apply.

questions.label: Any retirement distributions, pension, or Social Security income?
Any unemployment or gambling income?
Any rental property income?
Did you or a possible dependent have college education expenses?
questions.help: Include college tuition, required books, scholarships and grants for you or a possible dependent. Do not enter financial account numbers.

questions.label: Did you pay care expenses so you or your spouse could work or look for work?
Did anyone on your return have Marketplace health insurance (1095-A)?
questions.help: Marketplace coverage generally comes with Form 1095-A. Employer coverage is different. Choose Not sure if you cannot tell.

questions.label: Any HSA contributions or distributions?
questions.help: An HSA is a health savings account, not the same as an FSA. Contributions and withdrawals can both create reporting needs.

questions.label: Did you contribute to an IRA or workplace retirement plan?
Any mortgage interest, property taxes, donations, medical costs, or student loan interest?
Any tips, overtime, vehicle purchases, home energy improvements, or other major changes?
Describe the change and when it happened. Your preparer will check the tax-year rules.
Any foreign income, accounts, assets, or ownership interests?
questions.help: Include foreign income, bank or investment accounts, and business interests. Do not enter account numbers or exact balances here.

questions.label: Did you make estimated payments, file an extension, or receive tax notices?
questions.help: Tell us whether any payments, extensions or notices exist. Keep confirmations for secure collection later.

questions.label: Anything else your preparer should know? Enter None if nothing else. Do not enter SSNs, EINs, bank numbers, or document contents.
May US Tax Deals save these answers and contact you about this intake?
questions.help: Agreeing lets US Tax Deals retain these answers and contact you about this intake. If you do not agree, your answers will not be submitted.

questions.label: What is your full name?
questions.help: Use the name you want our preparer to use when contacting you. No identification document is needed here.

questions.label: Which email can our team use to contact you?
Which tax year are you filing for?
questions.help: The tax year is the year your income and activity relate to, not necessarily the year you submit the return.

questions.label: Enter the four-digit tax year.
Which states did you live in or do business in during that year?
questions.help: List state names only. Include states where you moved, worked, or had business activity so your preparer can check state filing needs.

questions.label: What is the business name? Do not enter its EIN.
How is the business taxed?
questions.help: An LLC is a legal structure. Its federal tax treatment can differ.

questions.label: Briefly describe what the business does.
What is the fiscal year-end date (month/day)?
How many owners are there, and did ownership change during the year? No owner IDs needed.
questions.help: Give a count and a brief description of changes. Do not enter owner SSNs, ITINs or other identification numbers.

questions.label: Are year-end bookkeeping records ready?
questions.help: Ready means your year-end income, expenses and account reconciliations are organized. Choose Partially or No if you need bookkeeping help.

questions.label: Did the business pay employees or owner wages?
questions.help: Include employees and any wages paid to owners. Contractor payments are asked about in the next question.

questions.label: Did the business pay independent contractors?
questions.help: Think about payments to independent service providers. Your preparer will review reporting requirements and request records securely.

questions.label: Did the business buy or sell inventory?
questions.help: Inventory means goods held for sale. Your preparer may need beginning and ending inventory values and purchase records.

questions.label: Any equipment, vehicles, property purchases, sales, or disposals?
questions.help: Include business equipment, vehicles and property bought, sold or disposed of. Your preparer will check the rules for the relevant year.

questions.label: Any business loans, owner contributions, distributions, or related-party transactions?
questions.help: Include business borrowing and money owners put into or took out of the company. Tax treatment depends on the entity and records.

questions.label: Any foreign owners, accounts, income, or international transactions?
questions.help: Include foreign income, bank or investment accounts, and business interests. Do not enter account numbers or exact balances here.

questions.label: Did the business operate, sell, employ people, or hold property in more than one state?
questions.help: Include locations of sales, workers, offices, inventory or property. Your preparer will review whether more than one state return is needed.

questions.label: Any estimated tax payments, extensions, or IRS/state notices?
questions.help: Tell us whether any payments, extensions or notices exist. Keep confirmations for secure collection later.

questions.label: Anything else your preparer should know? Enter None if nothing else. Do not enter SSNs, EINs, bank numbers, or document contents.

questions.help: Agreeing lets US Tax Deals retain these answers and contact you about this intake. If you do not agree, your answers will not be submitted.
